hook: SCP-2933 is a rusting steel labyrinth half sunk in a saltwater reservoir, with someone waiting at the bottom. Most of the file is one D-class's descent, told through his radio log, and the voice he meets is the reason to read it.
whyItMatters:
The entry shows how much a single conversation can carry. D-13321 is a weary, decent narrator who knows early that he is not coming back, and the entity he finds is unfailingly polite while clearly in agony, which makes the exchange between them both tender and grim.

It also belongs to Dr. Wondertainment's Little Misters line, and the recovered checklist turns a horror story into one entry in a cheerful collectible set.
thingsToNotice:
The structure itself is the trap: every passage leads down, the way back disappears, and anyone inside slowly turns to rust from the skin inward. D-13321's skin is flaking and burning long before he reaches the huge room, and his questions to the entity are practical ones, ending with whether it has a cigarette.

The entity scrapes away the rust on its leg, and with it a label calling it Scary and naming The Factory as its owner, then proudly shows the tattoo underneath, which calls it Smiles and credits Dr. Wondertainment. Its story is that its father, sick with rust, promised to make everyone smile if it took the rust from him, then grew afraid of it and sealed it away down here. On the checklist found beside it, Scary is the entry that has been ticked, and the final addendum sends a drone in after the human attempts failed.

related.note: Another Little Mister; Mr. Lost appears as number 16 on this file's checklist.
